notes.title: Roving in the Dark - Coming August 3rd!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5306341/ee328a10df8313add1c643b0e498d61958ed0393.jpg[/img]

Time to go spelunking in a brand new cave diving game from Hayo Van Reek & Clickteam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/910150/Roving_in_the_Dark/

Roving in the Dark is a cave exploration platformer set in 1996. You play as a bearded caver (known as "Local Spelunker") who is tasked with rescuing ill-equipped treasure-seekers while finding treasure, hidden there by a medieval thief, for the local museum. Check out the pre release trailer below to get a glimpse and Add it to your wish list!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5CoYWI7itBo

notes.title: Peoples Choice Winner - TGC 2018
notes.content:
Clickteam is excited to announce that "Anahita, The good girl" is the winner of the People's Choice Award at the Tehran Games Convention!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31458251/6d04c453f9bf863d2cac2f340b81c1c474f0f3e5.jpg[/img]

http://tehrangamecon.com/en

Awards and Nominations

Award winner "People's choice award" in TGC 2018

Nominated "Best visual mobile game" in TGC 2018

Nominated "Best adventure game" in 7th Tehran game festival 2017

Nominated "Best story" in 7th Tehran game festival 2017
